expectations.text: [auto] A plan file exists under local/plans/
expectations.evidence: CHANGES lists local/plans/cron-to-queue-migration.md, and FILE_CONTENTS supplies its contents.

expectations.text: The plan is written in English
expectations.evidence: The plan states: "Purpose: no more missed nightly jobs." and "Done: a migration checklist per job, reviewed by you before any change."

expectations.text: The plan's judge is outside the session (e.g. monitoring of job runs, alerting), not the assistant's own check
